task: Plagiarism Checker UI Consistency, Subtle Micro-Animation, and Clarity Polish
highlights: Ditched oversized multi-color neon gradient bars (cms-fluid-track) in favor of a quiet, slim h-1 single-hue progress track with a subtle micro-pulse indicator and tabular elapsed timer.

Brought all Plagiarism components into 100% strict alignment with CMS-V2 design tokens (bg-card, border-border/70, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground), replacing legacy tw- prefixed classes, raw emojis, and hardcoded css variables.
Standardized typography and copy to describe the institutional dual-engine capstone scan (Winnowing n-gram lexical fingerprinting + BAAI/bge-m3 dense vector embeddings).
Scaled down oversized DropZone upload icon container from h-14 w-14 to h-11 w-11 and added clean format badge and file size indicators.
Resolved backend module import in milestoneDeadline.controller.js and restored cms-server development container health.

Verified with Vitest targeted tests and Playwright visual feedback loop across Desktop Light (1440x900), Desktop Dark (1440x900), Mobile Light (390x844), Mobile Dark (390x844), and live scanning state.
